preceding_paragraph: Table S7 | Stratified language-model re-ranking of the projection predictor's Top-3 candidates under H2. Single noise realization; base accuracy 414/540 (76.7%); 120 sampled errors and 60 sampled correct controls (sampling seed 41); 57 of the 126 population errors and 55 of the 120 sampled errors had the true partition within the Top-3 list. Recovered is the number of sampled errors corrected; broken is the number of sampled correct predictions made incorrect; failures are request failures, invalid first choices and parsing failures, which fell back to the projection Top-1. The estimated change is (1 − p₀)r − p₀b with p₀ = 0.767, expressed in percentage points, and the estimated Top-1 is p₀ plus that change. Model identifiers are the service tags used for the requests and do not identify immutable model-weight versions. Explanation quality was not evaluated.
